stories.title: 4 cops including DSP martyred, 2 terrorists killed during exchange of fire in KP's Karak: police
stories.brief: LAKKI MARWAT: Four policemen, including two officials, were martyred and two terrorists were killed during an exchange of fire in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Karak district on Thursday, police said.

stories.title: DSP among 4 CTD, police personnel martyred in Karak attack
stories.brief: Four police personnel, including a deputy superintendent of police (DSP) of the Counter-Terrorism Department (CTD), were martyred on Thursday in an exchange of fire with armed men in the Khurram Muhammad Zai area of Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa's Karak district.

stories.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
stories.brief: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.

stories.title: Websites taken down worldwide as critical cyber-security update issued
stories.brief: The vulnerabilities with PHP, a programming language widely used across the internet, have been described as the most significant ever found by AI.

stories.title: ATC replaces state counsel in security breach case after Imaan, Hadi object to appointment
stories.brief: RAWALPINDI: An anti-terrorism court (ATC) on Thursday cancelled the appointment of state counsel Taimoor Janjua in a security breach case against lawyers Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and Hadi Ali Chattha, after the accused objected to his past conduct in another case.

stories.title: ATC replaces state counsel after Imaan, Hadi object to appointment
stories.brief: Judge Tahir Abbas Sipra, who heard the case at Adiala Jail, accepted an application filed by Imaan and Hadi challenging Janjua’s appointment and appointed Atif Mahmood as the new state counsel.

stories.title: Zuckerberg wins Meta deal to help him foot bill for possible California billionaire tax
stories.brief: The Meta boss had said he would exit the state over a wealth tax that has not yet come into force.

stories.title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
stories.brief: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.

stories.title: Why is Elon Musk plotting a mega-merger of SpaceX and Tesla?
stories.brief: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

stories.title: Why is a peat fire so bad? BBC is in Indonesia to find out
stories.brief: The BBC's Liza Tambunan is in central Kalimantan, to explain what peat is and why Indonesia is facing its worst wildfire season in a decade.

stories.title: 3 terrorists killed as security forces foil attack on construction camp in Gwadar: state media
stories.brief: Security forces have killed three terrorists belonging to Fitna al-Hindustan while foiling an attempt to attack an unoccupied camp of a construction company in Balochistan's Gwadar, state-owned Radio Pakistan reported on Thursday, citing security sources.

stories.title: Tally hits 95 as two more monkeypox cases reported in Sindh
stories.brief: Experts said mpox is a viral disease that can spread through close physical or skin-to-skin contact with an infected person, as well as contact with lesions, bodily fluids or contaminated objects. People developing symptoms have been advised to avoid close contact with others and seek immediate medical evaluation and diagnostic testing.

stories.title: Pakistan, Maldives move to establish direct air links
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday said he had directed the Ministry of Aviation to explore ways to establish direct flights between Pakistan and the Maldives, as the two countries agreed to strengthen air connectivity and expand bilateral trade.

stories.title: Karachi judicial magistrate rejects bail plea of anchorperson Iqrarul Hassan
stories.brief: KARACHI: A local court on Thursday rejected TV anchorperson Iqrarul Hassan’s bail plea in a cybercrime case pertaining to the alleged dissemination of anti-state content. Earlier this week, Hassan was sent to prison on judicial remand after the NCCIA sought an extension of his physical remand by another eight days.

stories.title: Karachi court rejects Iqrarul Hassan's bail plea in anti-state content case
stories.brief: The District and Sessions Court East dismissed a petition challenging Hassan's physical remand, with the defence counsel questioning the legality of the proceedings and arguing that the case concerned digital and cyber matters. The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) registered the case against Hassan, who is currently in jail on judicial remand.

stories.title: US-sanctioned ICC wins Sakharov Prize, EU’s top human rights award
stories.brief: The prize comes less than two weeks after US President Donald Trump announced sanctions against the court.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
stories.brief: 41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights recordLewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s.

stories.title: What is the history behind Trump’s LeBron blast over US national anthem?
stories.brief: What led to LeBron James being labelled a disgrace by US President Donald Trump, who says NBA star disgraced anthem?

stories.title: Sharp drops for AI stocks overwhelm markets worldwide as oil prices jump
stories.brief: The weakness for tech stocks was so overwhelming that it masked strength for the rest of the US market, in which the majority of stocks actually rose. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 11 points, or less than 0.1%.

stories.title: Gasps as Prince William makes surprise appearance on Graham Norton Show
stories.brief: The Prince of Wales was marking his Earthshot Prize, to which all of Norton's guests were linked.
